what_it_is: The human faculty review of the ten development management paths of one GI haemorrhage case (the Management Trace construct GI_MANAGEMENT_TRACE_V1), recorded as HUMAN evidence as the reviewer reported it. It is not converted into an automated truth, it is not a clinical validation, and nothing in it was written by a model. No answer, comment, event or timestamp that was not reported was added.
